extracted.intended_audience: eRA Commons users responsible for grant closeout (signing officials (SO), program directors/principal investigators (PD/PI), delegated submitters, and institutional grants administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and policy guidance for preparing, saving, previewing, and submitting closeout reports and related documents in eRA Commons (e.g., Final Invention Statement, Final RPPR, FRAM, FPR, FFR, Additional Materials). Includes role-based permissions and agency-specific notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Invention Statement submission timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: You must submit a Final Invention Statement (FIS) within 120 days following the termination of a grant award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The statement should include all inventions that were conceived or first reduced to practice during the course of work under the grant or award, from the original effective date of support through the date of completion or termination. For HHS-funded awards, refer to the Procedure for Submission of Final Invention Statement and Certification. If award is funded by a non-NIH/non-AHRQ source, check with the awarding agency for policy guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who can edit vs who can submit closeout reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Either a program director/principal investigator (PD/PI) or a signing official (SO) can edit many closeout items (upload, preview, delete, save), but only an SO or a user with delegated report submit authority can submit the reports or other data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This rule is repeated across modules (Final Invention Statement, FRAM, Additional Materials, FPR, FFR). PIs can initiate and save but do not see the Submit button unless explicitly delegated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required content for the Final Invention Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: The statement should include all inventions that were conceived or first reduced to practice during the course of work under the grant or award, from the original effective date of support through the date of completion or termination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure inventions are listed that occurred during the entire support period; agency-specific policy language may appear on the screen (e.g., NIH/AHRQ).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fields required to add an invention in eRA Commons
rubrics_metrics.description: To add an invention: Type the Name of Inventor, Title of Invention, and the Date Reported to DHSS (the date you want to officially report it to the Department of Health and Human Services). Then click the Add Invention and Save button.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After clicking Add Invention and Save, a Confirm Invention popup appears with customized language depending on funding agency. Click Agree and Continue in the popup even if you have more inventions to add. Any inventions you define are saved immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ability to delete inventions prior to submission
rubrics_metrics.description: As long as the final invention statement has not yet been submitted, either a PI or SO who views this screen can click an item's Delete Invention and Save link in the Action column to remove it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once the FIS is submitted, submitted items are captured in the submitted PDF and a View action appears; deletion of submitted items is not permitted from the submitted view.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preview function for Final Invention Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Click the Preview (Inventions Reported) button to download a PDF copy of the final invention statement form filled out with the entered information and grant information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When no inventions are reported, the preview button name changes to Preview (No Inventions Reported). Use Preview to confirm contents before submitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submitting the Final Invention Statement (SO-only)
rubrics_metrics.description: When all the inventions are listed at the bottom of the screen, click the Submit button to submit the invention statement to the awarding agency. (Only the SO can submit—the PI does not see a Submit button.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A Confirm Invention popup appears; click Agree and Continue to complete submission. After submission, the submitted PDF is available on the Closeout Status screen via the View button and the Final Invention Statement task indicates Status = Submitted with submission details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting no inventions workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: To complete a final invention statement certifying that no inventions exist: Click the Save with No Inventions button, confirm the Preview button has been renamed to 'Preview (No Inventions Reported)', then click the Submit button to submit a statement indicating no inventions are being reported. (Only the SO sees a Submit button and has the ability to submit.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A certification popup appears; click Agree and Continue. After submission, the submitted PDF is available via View on Closeout Status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose and structure of FRAM (Final Progress Report Additional Materials)
rubrics_metrics.description: The FRAM link provides a means for recipients to enter, review, route, and submit information in response to specific request(s) by the program official (PO) for additional information related to the Final RPPR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FRAM has two sections: FRAM Upload Additional Materials (for file uploads) and Revised Outcome (for typing/pasting a revised 'I. Outcomes' section). Policy guidance appears under the Revised Outcome section and includes samples of acceptable project outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: FRAM initiation and submitter roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Either the PD/PI or SO can initiate the FRAM and attach a file or type/paste a Revised Project Outcome, but only an SO can submit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read the certification language at the top of the FRAM screen before submitting. For some agencies (e.g., SAMHSA), the Revised Project Outcome section is not applicable; agency-specific text is displayed on the screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: File upload and management behavior (FRAM, Additional Materials, FPR, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Upload by drag-and-drop or browse; the drop area specifies how many files and what file types are allowed. For uploaded files you can click the Download icon to open/download the file or click the Delete icon to remove the file. Click Save to save the submission package but not submit; click Delete to discard the current submission package.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After submission, a View action appears on Closeout Status (PDF or ZIP depending on agency) showing application info, who uploaded files and when, followed by uploaded file contents. For some modules (Additional Materials), each new submission can replace prior submission(s) or append files depending on agency/module behavior.

rubrics_metrics.name: FRAM post-submission behavior and notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: After you submit the FRAM, a View action appears on Closeout Status; the FRAM Update action remains until acceptance of the Final RPPR, enabling you to upload more files; however, you cannot make changes to files already submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An email notification is sent to the SO who submitted the FRAM and to the PI; a separate notification is sent to the PO. The PO may rescind approval of the Final RPPR or FPR at any time, in which case the FRAM Update action appears for submitting FRAM again.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revised Outcome submission guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Read the policy guidance in the Revised Outcome section prior to submitting a revised outcome. Type or paste the revised outcome description into the text box provided; tool icons provide basic editing tools (bold, italic, bullets, numbering, indenting).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agency-specific notices (for NIH see NOT-OD-17-022 and NOT-OD-17-037) provide additional policy guidance and examples of acceptable project outcomes; samples are linked from the screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: CDC-specific Additional Materials closeout task applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: CDC awardees will see the Additional Materials closeout task to submit any other required documents as stated in Terms and Conditions of the award. This topic applies only to CDC awards. Only CDC awards have this type of closeout requirement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only an SO or a user with delegated report submit authority can submit; PD/PI can upload/preview/delete/save but cannot submit. Use the Additional Material(s) button to upload files; Preview shows a PDF with application info and uploaded file contents. After submitting, you can continue to upload and submit additional materials as needed; each submission replaces the prior submission until accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Financial Report (FFR) closeout requirement and handling
rubrics_metrics.description: The Federal Financial Report (FFR) is required for closeout and should be prepared according to instructions provided by the awarding agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commons users with the FSR role can see the Manage Final FFR action and are redirected to the FFR module. For DHHS-funded awards, the FFR is initiated from eRA Commons but users are redirected to the Payment Management System (PMS) to complete and submit; users need appropriate PMS access. For DOC-funded awards, users initiate and fill out the FFR form within eRA Commons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final RPPR (non-NIH) form applicability and submission
rubrics_metrics.description: For Final RPPRs (non-NIH) consult the awarding agency for policy guidance. The F. Changes form and the H. Budget form are not applicable for Final RPPRs. The I. Outcomes form is applicable only for Final RPPRs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Log into eRA Commons as the contact PD/PI to access Closeout Status; the PI can initiate the Final RPPR and the SO is the only user who can submit. If an Initiate button appears click it; after initiation access Edit RPPR from the three-dot ellipsis and fill out and submit (SO only).

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Progress Report (FPR) initiation, editing, and submission rules
rubrics_metrics.description: For closeout requiring a Final Progress Report (FPR), both the PD/PI and the SO see an Initiate Final Progress Report button; either can initiate and add files and save. Only the SO can click Submit to submit the document to the agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uploaded files can be saved without submitting (Save). After the SO submits, users can initiate and submit new iterations; new files appended to previous submissions. Prior submitted files cannot be removed by initiating a new iteration. Use View Prior Submission to download what has been submitted (DOC returns ZIP; SAMHSA returns PDF). If an FPR was previously initiated and saved but not submitted, an Edit button appears allowing PI or SO to add/remove files and save; SO can submit when ready.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Closeout Documentation (DOC) status indicators and workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: When providing Additional Closeout Documentation, a popup lists required documents and uses icons to indicate status: hollow blue hand = not yet submitted; green circle with white checkmark = submitted; solid green hand thumbs up = accepted by agency; solid red triangle with white exclamation point = returned by agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Click any row to upload a document; if a document has already been submitted you can still submit an additional document and it is added to prior submissions. The Additional Closeout Documentation screen shows a description of the file to be uploaded above the upload area. Use Save to save uploaded submission package but not submit; Submit (SO only) to submit. After saving, others can remove or add files to the unsubmitted package; after submitting you can initiate a new submission which appends new submissions to prior submissions.
